business_scope.primary_industry_name: Virtual Private Network and Digital Encryption Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (US-derived) with customary law elements
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force.
Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (1986, amended 2003).

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2002, as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Regulations; Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended; Registered Agents Act; and Financial Intelligence Unit directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the ultimate beneficial owner's valid passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the owner's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the origin state is a party; otherwise consular legalization through the Marshall Islands consular mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Utility bill or bank reference letter evidencing the beneficial owner's physical residential/business address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, licensed bank, or government authority in the owner's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized beneficial ownership declaration and source-of-wealth questionnaire
Certified copy of the corporate chart/register of the immediate shareholder entity, if any
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the immediate shareholder entity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs); mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, authorized signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit domestic sanctions and watchlist. Negative news and adverse media checks, source-of-wealth verification, and ongoing transaction monitoring are required for medium-risk virtual network security businesses.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Companies Registry Online Portal operated by the Registrar of Corporations through International Registries, Inc. (IRI)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin script using English or Marshallese orthography. Names may contain numerals and punctuation approved by the Registrar. Any non-Latin-script words must be fully transliterated into Latin script, and a certified transliteration must be retained by the registered agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of rejection, the applicant may submit a written request to the Registrar of Corporations for administrative reconsideration, supported by a legal memorandum addressing the grounds of rejection and, where applicable, a consent or non-objection letter from the relevant minister or authority if the name is a prohibited or sensitive token. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands in accordance with the Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be used only as a secondary administrative address. The registered office on Majuro must be a physical location maintained by a licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands. For this VPN and digital encryption software business, no statutory industry license is required, but the physical registered-office requirement remains absolute.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25 percent likelihood of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within a three-year compliance cycle for a medium-risk network-security SaaS entity engaged in VPN and encryption services.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee prescribed by the Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Quoted logistics charge from designated courier for authenticated document shipment

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA), as amended, §§ 24, 27, 29, 43-44, 75-78, 155; non-resident corporation provisions under the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filings transmitted through a licensed registered agent under the Registered Agents Act)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1), resulting in issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. No escrow account or capital deposit is required; shares may be issued as fully paid in exchange for cash, property, or services, with stated capital as designated in the Articles of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers' offers to acquire the Corporation's common shares are accepted, and shares are issued as fully paid in the share subscription ledger; RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be maintained at the office of the licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands, and such agent is retained as statutory representative; RESOLVED, that the incumbent directors continue until the first annual meeting; RESOLVED, that the officers are appointed, namely a Chief Executive Officer, Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer, with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and file statutory notices; RESOLVED, that this consent constitutes the First Board Resolution of the Corporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability reservation and engagement of licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent; Registrar of Corporations (through agent submission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability search for the proposed corporate name. Once the name is cleared, execute the engagement letter with a licensed RMI registered agent and complete the anti-money laundering due-diligence file. The registered agent reserves the name with the Registrar and issues a name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed corporate intake and due-diligence questionnaire
Name availability search request
Passport copy and proof of residential address for each shareholder and director
Bank reference or professional reference for each beneficial owner
Signed engagement letter with licensed RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is refused due to similarity or an impermissible term, submit an alternate name via the registered agent; a written explanation addressing the Registrar's objection may be filed before a final refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator/subscribers, notary public, registered agent, and Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in the prescribed form. The articles must state the corporate name, the registered office address in the Marshall Islands, the name of the licensed registered agent, the authorized capital and par value, the number of directors, and the corporate purpose of providing VPN, digital encryption, and network-security software and related lawful activities. The articles must be signed by the incorporator or subscribers; if executed outside the Marshall Islands, the signature should be notarized. Deliver the signed original and certified copy to the registered agent for filing with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation in ink
Notarized copy of the Articles of Incorporation
Consent of the licensed registered agent to act
Name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency memorandum, cure by filing corrected articles or a written explanation within 30 days; if necessary, restate the corporate name or appointed agent and resubmit with the applicable fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing, fee payment, and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the registered agent, submit the executed Articles of Incorporation and the prescribed government filing fee to the Registrar. The Registrar verifies statutory compliance, stamps the filing date, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation together with an authenticated copy of the articles. The certificate is conclusive evidence that the corporation is duly formed and authorized to transact business within the scope of its stated purposes.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation
Transmittal letter from the registered agent
Government fee remittance record
Registered agent consent form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance is delayed beyond the service-level agreement, request expedited processing; where a deficit is claimed, provide the remittance receipt and reconcile payment with the Registrar's fee schedule; if Registry error caused delay, request correction and back-dating of the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational meeting, adoption of bylaws, and appointment of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial board of directors; corporate secretary; licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting of the initial directors, or act by unanimous written consent. The directors adopt the corporate bylaws, approve the issuance of common shares to the subscribers, open the share register, establish the registered office as approved, appoint the Chief Executive Officer, Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer, and authorize the opening of bank accounts and execution of commercial agreements. All resolutions must be recorded in board minutes or written consents and retained in the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Waiver of notice or unanimous written consent of the initial directors
Adopted corporate bylaws
Share subscription agreements and share register certificate
Officer acceptance and biographical forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any organizational act is challenged for defective notice or quorum, cure it by a unanimous written consent and ratification resolution executed by all directors, and keep a secretary's certificate recording the cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Non-resident tax status confirmation and licensing assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent; Registrar of Corporations; Ministry of Finance/Revenue Administration; RMI Environmental Protection Authority only if physical presence is established
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the corporation's non-resident status and ensure no RMI-source income will be earned from the VPN software platform. File the corporate annual registry statement to maintain good standing. Since the activity is a purely digital network-security service, no industrial license or environmental permit is required; however, if a physical office, data center, or employees are later established in the Marshall Islands, the corporation must apply for the applicable local business license and environmental/fire clearances before commencement.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of good standing if required
Beneficial ownership register
Declaration of no RMI-source income
Local business license application only if physical presence is established
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Revenue Administration issues an information notice, respond through RMI counsel with a memorandum confirming the non-resident exemption; any adverse determination may be administratively appealed within 30 days of the notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a non-manufacturing, remote digital service company; if physical establishment occurs, the Ministry of Finance Business License Office and the Registrar of Corporations become relevant.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license is required. The Certificate of Incorporation is the sole corporate authorization for offshore SaaS/VPN services; a local Business License is required only if an onshore office or physical operations are later established.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: No EIA required for the virtual software/SaaS activity; classified as an informational/minor action unless a data center, standby generators, or waste-producing equipment are physically installed in the Marshall Islands.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater, VOC, or hazardous-air emissions arise from the pure software operation. If physical infrastructure is deployed, compliance with RMIEPA water quality standards, diesel-generator emission thresholds, and Basel Convention e-waste disposal requirements will apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for a remote, non-resident digital corporation. If a physical office is established, the corporation must obtain the Majuro fire-prevention certificate, structural-load and building inspection clearance, and Labor Act workplace inspection clearance before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) - official national portal: https://www.rmigov.com. Corporate registry functions are administered separately by the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro (registered agent filing portal for Business Corporations). The RMI has no federal income-tax administration, no TIN-issuance bureau, and no VAT authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No income-tax TIN or VAT ID exists for non-resident Business Corporations (BC) in the RMI; the Certificate of Incorporation is the sole statutory identifier. Procedure: (1) file Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations through a licensed RMI registered agent, electing non-resident domestic corporation status; (2) pay the fixed government filing fee (approximately USD 200-500 depending on share structure); (3) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; (4) if the corporation holds no RMI assets, employs no RMI residents, and does not do business in the RMI, no further revenue-authority registration is triggered; (5) only upon physical import of goods, local employment, or leasing of RMI premises would the entity require an importer registration, municipal business license, and Social Security Administration registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Available elections: (a) statutory non-resident domestic corporation election filed with the Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990, which confirms full exemption from RMI income taxation on all non-RMI-source income; (b) close corporation governance election (no tax effect); (c) no RMI check-the-box, CFC, hybrid-mismatch, or substitute-tax election exists. For U.S.-owned structures, an IRS Form 8832 entity-classification election may be made separately for U.S. federal purposes, but this does not affect RMI status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None applicable - the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax; the only indirect impositions are customs import duty on physical goods entering RMI territory and municipal business license fees in Majuro and Kwajalein.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not Applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. A customs importer registration may be triggered on physical importation of goods (duty generally ranges from 2% to 15% depending on tariff classification); VPN network privacy services delivered electronically have no customs nexus and no registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandate. The RMI has no electronic-invoicing system, no real-time fiscal clearance, no API reporting regime, and no digital stamping requirement. Standard commercial PDF or platform-generated invoices are sufficient; prudent practice is to retain the invoice and payment trail for at least 7 years for foreign audit contingencies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - because the RMI levies no VAT/GST, there is no export zero-rating mechanism, no export VAT refund regime, and no statutory zero-rating claim to file. VPN/SaaS subscription revenues from foreign customers are outside the scope of any RMI indirect tax. RMI law imposes no exchange-control or FX-repatriation deadline; the 180-day figure in this dossier is a schema-normalized default and not a statutory requirement. USD is the official currency and funds are freely repatriable without Central Bank approval.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable - no RMI export VAT zero-rating claim, export customs declaration, or exit certificate is required for electronically supplied VPN and privacy software services

Recommended substantive records for audit defense: executed SaaS master services agreement, itemized commercial invoices, payment settlement statements from Stripe and Paymentwall, and technical service-delivery logs (endpoint sessions, data-transfer volumes, and IP routing evidence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback regime exists because no VAT is imposed. Residual legal exposure: (i) if audit findings establish that the BC is in fact 'doing business' in the RMI, the entity becomes liable for RMI Social Security Act contributions (7% employer/7% employee on covered local payroll), Health Care Fund levies, and municipal business license taxes, with interest and penalties on arrears; (ii) false declarations to the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act can trigger corporate dissolution, fines, and director liability; (iii) foreign-owner jurisdictions (e.g., U.S. GILTI/CFC and OECD BEPS Action 2 hybrid rules) may recharacterize the exempt entity, producing home-jurisdiction clawbacks of any foreign tax credits, but this is outside RMI law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The RMI maintains no domestic central bank; the U.S. dollar is sole legal tender under the Amended Compact of Free Association, making the U.S. Federal Reserve the de facto monetary anchor and U.S. dollar clearing systems the domestic payment backbone.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full currency convertibility exists under RMI law. No exchange controls, capital account licensing, or profit-remittance permits apply to resident or non-resident business corporations. Dividends, shareholder distributions, and liquidation proceeds are freely repatriated in USD, subject only to the solvency and balance-sheet distribution tests under the Business Corporations Act 1990. Current-account items (SaaS subscription income, royalty and licensing streams, management fees) are freely transferable without central bank approval. The sole practical restriction is extraterritorial: RMI banks clear exclusively through U.S. correspondent accounts, so every USD transfer is screened under U.S. OFAC sanctions and Bank Secrecy Act rules, exposing the account to freeze risk if a counterparty is sanctioned or anomalous.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. The RMI imposes no repatriation timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export receipts. Digital software exporters, including the VPN merchant, may keep receipts in any bank in any jurisdiction, hold any currency, and convert at commercial market rates without regulatory filing.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Business Checking (non-interest-bearing demand deposit); capital escrow not required given zero minimum capital regime
Operational USD Corporate Demand Deposit account; separate merchant settlement account optional for Stripe/Paymentwall payouts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium with conditions. EEA- and UK-licensed electronic money institutions and global payments platforms can service a non-resident Marshall Islands business corporation, but the VPN/privacy-app classification pushes every application into enhanced due diligence with discretionary review. Approval likelihood is below that of an operating company in a high-tax jurisdiction; a complete corporate registry pack, transparent beneficial ownership chain, demonstrable product legitimacy, absence of crypto-anonymity features, and a live merchant record with Stripe/Paymentwall are mandatory. EMIs domiciled in unregulated offshore territories are structurally unacceptable and should be excluded.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Banking Act 1988 (as amended) contains no express in-person appearance mandate. In practice, domestic banks apply a de facto physical presence policy for non-resident corporations: at least one director or the designated compliance officer must complete an in-person KYC interview at the bank's Majuro branch, at Bank of Guam's corporate offices in Guam, or before a bank-recognised notary. Remote video verification is conditionally accepted for signatories with a valid internationally recognised passport and a certifying AML officer; however, first-time onboarding of an offshore VPN SaaS company realistically requires one physical signing session in Guam or Honolulu before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Privacy-enhancement software business model with anonymous, non-KYC retail subscribers and worldwide digital distribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-code ownership and development history; published privacy policy and terms of use; FATF risk-classification memorandum; logical access audit trail for administrative accounts; data-retention and law-enforcement disclosure policy; demonstrable absence of crypto mixing, tumbler, or anonymity-layer functionality; PCI DSS attestation of compliance; chargeback and fraud-management programme; end-customer acceptable-use and fair-use policies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident corporate shell profile: RMI business corporation with no local offices, no employees, and no substantive local operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing; articles of incorporation and bylaws; register of directors and officers; full share register with complete beneficial ownership chain; sworn beneficial ownership declaration; 24-month management accounts or audited financial statements; board resolution authorising account opening; commercial substance description covering hosting contracts, SaaS infrastructure and route to market; confirmation that RMI domicile is used solely for legal-structure optimisation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value cross-border card merchant profile via Stripe and Paymentwall for an unlicensed software service, raising chargeback and abuse risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed merchant acquirer agreements with Stripe and Paymentwall; ticket-size and revenue analytics; refund and chargeback policy with dispute-resolution workflow; sanctions-screening process for end customers; transaction monitoring rules with threshold escalation; triennial AML/CTF programme; engagement of an external screening vendor (e.g., Refinitiv or equivalent) evidencing ongoing vendor due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: U.S.-dollar clearing nexus and OFAC exposure from potential unlawful VPN use in sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export-control legal opinion confirming VPN software is not an ITAR or EAR-controlled item; geo-blocking policy for Iran, Syria, North Korea, Cuba and Crimea; IP-geolocation blocking implementation; contractual customer confirmation of non-sanctioned residence; quarterly IP-address ledger demonstrating blocked traffic from prohibited jurisdictions; confirmation of no expected payment flows from sanctioned persons or entities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All injections are executed in USD via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank. Recommended purpose code: A1 (direct investment in an enterprise). Verification bundle: board resolution authorising share issuance; executed subscription agreement; issued share certificate; solvency certificate; source-of-funds letter from the shareholder's registered agent; confirmation of non-sanctioned fund origin. Intra-group funding should be structured as a shareholder loan under purpose code B2 with executed loan agreement, arm's-length interest schedule, and intercompany transfer pricing documentation. All MT103 messages are subject to U.S. correspondent screening; the beneficiary reference line must state "Beneficiary: MH_BC — Purpose: Capital Injection / Share Subscription".
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational vendor payments use SWIFT MT103 for global wires to data-centre providers, hosting platforms, contractors, and licensors. Capital-intensive infrastructure procurement may be effected through a Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP 600 through Bank of Guam's trade desk, with confirmation by a U.S. money-center bank where seller risk justifies it. Recurring SaaS/cloud obligations are paid via U.S. ACH or Fedwire. Stripe and Paymentwall merchant settlements arrive by automated ACH payout or domestic wire into the operating USD account and are downstream disbursed via MT103/MT202. No RMI-specific clearing or reporting obligation applies; all USD clearing runs over Fedwire and CHIPS.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forwards (USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/AUD) with an internationally licensed bank counterparty under an ISDA Master Agreement
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on the same currency pairs, permitted as fallback where counterparty credit cannot accept an RMI-domiciled contract; RMI law imposes no restriction on NDFs
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/GBP) limited to intercompany loan exposures, authorised by board treasury delegation and documented under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Return (Business Corporation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; due on the date of the certificate of incorporation each subsequent year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$300; continued non-payment for 90 days after the due date triggers administrative dissolution and strike-off from the Corporate Registry with loss of legal existence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (submitted via Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the Annual Report on the anniversary of incorporation; any share transfer or UBO change must be notified within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file timely confirmation may subject the registered agent to monetary fines and suspension; persistent failure may support an application for administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit requirement for a non-resident Business Corporation unless demanded by shareholders holding at least 10% of outstanding shares or required by a license/regulatory condition.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP (voluntarily adopted; no Marshall Islands local GAAP exists).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Registered Agent must maintain an internal register of beneficial owners and file an annual confirmation with the Registrar as to whether any shareholding transfer or ownership change occurred. Any new beneficial owner or transfer must be recorded in the register and reported to the Registrar within 30 days of the event.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Marshall Islands levies no corporate income tax on non-resident Business Corporations. Such entities are entirely outside the RMI Gross Revenue Tax and reside within a statutory tax-exempt zone for offshore-derived income. No tax is assessed on worldwide income, capital gains, or dividends. The only fixed governmental charge is a flat annual registration fee of USD 50 payable under the Business Corporations Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for non-resident Business Corporations. The sole periodic filing is the annual corporate registry renewal statement administered by the registered agent through the Marshall Islands Registrar portal (Agent-Only Online Filing).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation each year as invoiced by the registered agent; no fiscal-year-based tax deadline applies. The registered agent submits the renewal statement and pays the USD 50 annual fee to the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate name and registration number confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify the exact legal name as in the Certificate of Incorporation and confirm the entity is registered as a non-resident domestic corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the registered agent's physical address only; do not reflect any local place of business because none is permitted without a RMI business license.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-resident status and absence of RMI-source revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expressly state that the corporation is a non-resident company, is managed and controlled outside the Marshall Islands, and derives no income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
Remit the fee through the registered agent; no tax computation, income schedule, or profit report is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to pay the annual fee and file the registry renewal before the anniversary date triggers the Registrar's late penalty (typically equal to the annual fee), loss of good standing, and, after continued default, compulsory strike-off from the register. A struck-off corporation loses its separate legal personality and its assets vest in the Registrar; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and legal costs.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a Marshall Islands non-resident Business Corporation; therefore no domestic dividend WHT is due. The Republic of the Marshall Islands has not entered into comprehensive double taxation agreements. Consequently, no treaty relief claim, Tax Residency Certificate, or administrative WHT exemption application is needed at the source level. A shareholding entity resident in a foreign jurisdiction may rely on its domestic foreign tax credit system for creditability; if a foreign tax authority requests proof of non-resident status, a certificate can be obtained from the Registrar evidencing that the corporation is a non-resident domestic entity.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A — no transfer pricing legislation, Local File, or Master File threshold exists in the Marshall Islands. The RMI does not impose corporate income tax, and no arm's-length adjustment is made for tax-exempt non-resident corporations. Where the ultimate beneficial owner is tax-resident in a high-tax jurisdiction, that jurisdiction's transfer pricing rules apply extraterritorially; contemporaneous documentation and substance records should nevertheless be retained to defend the non-resident status.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands adopts economic substance requirements via its Economic Substance Regulations. A non-resident Business Corporation is excluded from these obligations if it is not tax resident in the Marshall Islands and can evidence that management and control are exercised in another jurisdiction where it is subject to tax. ESP operations, including VPN and digital encryption software services, are not a standard pure-holding relevant activity unless the entity owns high-value intellectual property and conducts IP-holding functions. In any event, the company should retain board minutes demonstrating foreign management, keep its registered agent and office in the RMI, avoid local employees or office leases in the RMI, and never claim RMI tax residency. Failure to demonstrate non-resident status may bring the entity within the RMI ESR reporting framework, requiring an economic substance return and proof of adequate physical presence, qualified staff, and expenditure in the Marshall Islands.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Marshall Islands non-resident Business Corporation to conceal the real beneficial owner or to underreport profits earned through the VPN network privacy application sold to customers in the United States or European Union, while claiming no substance and filing no information returns with the foreign tax authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In the United States, IRC §7201 criminal tax evasion is punishable by up to 5 years' imprisonment and a maximum fine of US$250,000 for individuals (US$500,000 for corporations), plus payment of all evaded taxes and interest. The civil fraud penalty under IRC §6663 adds 75% of the underpayment attributable to fraud. Similar offshore-asset penalties may apply under FBAR for undisclosed accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing is available when the BC is a sham or mere instrumentality. Willful U.S. persons who are directors or shareholders can be held personally liable for FBAR penalties reaching 50% of hidden account balances per violation, and may be subjected to extradition, travel bans, and imprisonment for tax evasion conspiracy.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering the entity as non-resident while actual management and control are maintained from the Marshall Islands, or failing to produce any board minutes, bank records, or commercial documentation demonstrating healthy foreign management; alternatively using the BC solely as an IP holding shell with no foreign operational nexus.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations and Business Corporations Act, the Registrar may impose a fixed administrative penalty starting at US$10,000 for a first offence, escalating to US$50,000 for repeated non-compliance, in addition to enforcement strike-off and loss of good standing. Continued failure may result in compulsory dissolution and asset vesting in the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false non-resident declarations or provide misleading economic substance information can be prosecuted locally, with imprisonment of up to one year in addition to individual fines. Foreign courts may additionally treat such filings as director misconduct, creating personal civil liability for resulting losses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting VPN subscription payments through card-processing rails such as Stripe or Paymentwall without performing any customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, or sanctions screening, while routing proceeds to personal accounts or opaque corporate shells in low-risk jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Marshall Islands AML framework, together with its Criminal Code, treats money laundering and failure to report suspicious transactions as criminal offences. Penalties may reach 15 years' imprisonment and substantial fines, while asset forfeiture and freezing orders can without notice immobilise corporate bank accounts and third-party payment reserves.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly or recklessly facilitate laundering of proceeds through the VPN platform are subject to prosecution as accomplices; personal account assets are reachable through confiscation orders, travel bans are commonly issued in cross-border investigations, and prison terms run consecutively where multiple predicate offences are established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorized RMI Domestic Operations / Gross Revenue Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the non-resident tax classification while actually hiring employees in the Marshall Islands, renting a physical server room or office, or selling VPN services to RMI-resident customers, all without obtaining a RMI business license or filing Gross Revenue Tax returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Gross Revenue Tax law imposes a fixed gross receipts tax on any person or business engaged in commercial activity within the Marshall Islands; operating without a license and without filing exemptions triggers back assessments, interest, daily penalties for each day of unlicensed operation, and possible administrative suspension of local payment and banking activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who deliberately misrepresent the non-resident status or who cause the company to conceal local revenue may be held personally liable for unpaid gross revenue taxes and penalty assessments. In aggravated cases, criminal sanctions apply and directors may be prohibited from leaving the jurisdiction pending resolution of the tax debt.
